highlights: Sidley represented Sapiom, Inc. in its US$35 million Series A financing round, bringing the company’s total funding to US$50 million. The round was led by Dragonfly Capital Partners, LLC, with participation from Accel, Gradient Ventures, Coinbase Ventures, Operator Collective Management, L.L.C., Formus Capital, and VanEck Ventures.

results.title: Startup Sapiom routes clients’ AI to lowest-cost tokens  | Semafor
highlights: Sapiom is betting it can lower those token costs, and is raising a $35 million series A led by venture-fund Dragonfly’s Haseeb Qureshi. The company raised $15 million earlier this year in a seed round led by Accel. The company is also launching a new, single API key — a model router that automatically sends requests to the most efficient AI model for the job. The product puts it squarely in competition with OpenRouter, the biggest name in that field.

highlights:
# Sidley Represents Sapiom in US$15.75 Million Seed Financing
...
Sidley represented Sapiom, Inc., a company focused on building autonomous AI assistants for the financial services industry, in its US$15.75 million Series Seed financing, led by Accel. The round included participation from Gradient, Array Ventures, Okta Ventures, Menlo Ventures, Anthropic, Coinbase Ventures, Formus Capital, and Operator Collective. Several high-profile strategic angel investors also participated, including Shopify, OpenAI, Vercel, GitHub, Circle, and Mercury.
